# PPPoE Session (`pppoe_session`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: 6 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [L2 control protocols](../../protocols/l2-control.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) | `ethertype` | 34916 (0x8864) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(4)` | `1` |   | PPPoE protocol version (1). |
| `type` | `uint(4)` | `1` |   | PPPoE type (1). |
| `code` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | PPPoE code (PADI / PADO / PADR / PADS / PADT, 0 = session data). |
| `session_id` | `uint(16)` | `1` |   | PPPoE session identifier. |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the payload in octets | Length of the PPPoE payload, in octets (Auto). |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `session_id`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.
